skill.summary: Convert Markdown to Notion blocks with full format support. Handles bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, headings, lists, tables, callouts, and more.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of notion-md – convert Markdown to Notion blocks

- Converts Markdown to Notion blocks with support for bold, italic, strikethrough, code, headings, lists, tables, callouts, and more.
- Configurable via environment variables, including Notion API key and parent page ID.
- Includes commands for creating, appending, and listing Notion pages from Markdown input.
- Supports preview mode with `--dry-run`.
- Detailed Notion block mapping for all supported Markdown syntax.
- Easy setup instructions for API integration.
